about: Labelled user messages for the request router (spec §8; backlog step 6). Each case names a project state (see states), optional earlier user messages with the agent that answered each, and the routes that count as correct: the first is the intended one, the others are acceptable. Synthetic retail wording; nothing here comes from the eval answer keys.

cases.message: We need monthly net sales by store and product category.
Finance wants to see returns as a percentage of gross sales, by month and channel.
What does net revenue include? Is freight in or out?
Net sales means gross sales minus discounts and returns. Freight is excluded.
Answer to Q-002: returns are reported in the month the refund was issued, not the original order month.
A guest checkout is an order with no customer account. Count them as their own customer segment.
Drop the requirement for daily inventory snapshots; weekly is enough for the buyers.
Which requirements are still waiting on a definition?
I attached the merchandising glossary. Please record the terms it defines.
Sales by store should use the store that fulfilled the order, not the one where it was placed.
Marketing needs customer counts by loyalty tier and signup month.
Is a cancelled order counted in gross sales? I can't remember what we agreed.
Draft the model from the requirements.
Change fact_sales to order-line grain.
Why is dim_store connected to fact_sales twice?
Does the orders table in the source have one row per order or per order line?
What changed in the proposal waiting for review?
Make dim_customer a type 2 slowly changing dimension on loyalty tier.
Check whether the relationship between fact_returns and dim_product holds in the data.
Rename refund_amt to refund_amount and describe it better.
Is the unit price on the sales fact additive?
Design a first version even though no source is connected yet.
How many stores are in the source data, and are any of them closed?
Redo the proposal but keep the date dimension as it was.
Add a vendor dimension so we can report sales by vendor.
We now need gross margin by product, so add product cost to the model.
Net sales should exclude gift card purchases from now on; update the sales fact to match.
The buyers want weekly stock on hand by store and SKU. Please add it to the model.
Also track promotions so we can see sales lift per campaign, and then draft the model.
Returns should be counted by refund date instead of order date. Change the returns fact accordingly.
Before I apply it: we also need sales by sales associate, so add that.
Customer lifetime value by acquisition channel is a new requirement; model it.
Add a region attribute to stores so finance can roll up sales by region.
Loyalty tier means the tier at the time of purchase, not today's tier, so the customer dimension has to keep history.
